verdict.rationale: Square's Web Payments SDK (square-docs-31) provides embeddable, customizable payment UI components (card, ACH, Cash App, Afterpay) directly in a developer's own site rather than redirecting to a hosted checkout page, backed by the Payments API and SDKs (square-gh-1, square-gh-3, square-docs-5–8). Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer review/testimonial confirming customization ease and no explicit design-doc excerpt showing style/branding customization options beyond the docs list.
